description: Vogue Paris covers from one decade: the 1920s (flappers, Art Deco), the 1930s, the 1940s (wartime and the New Look) or the early 1950s. Returns up to 12 covers spread evenly across the decade as images, with the decade's issue count. Covers are images for 1930 and earlier; later decades return the issue list with reader links. Example questions: "1920s Vogue covers"; "Art Deco fashion magazine covers"; "Vogue in the 1940s".
name: vogue_covers_by_decade
title: Vogue covers by decade
